rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 9.0; cuts armour

rows.label: forsaken bow
rows.desc: This traditional Forsaken bow is very accurate and can deal decent damage. Its sharp edges make it usable in melee combat.

rows.label: close combat DMR
rows.desc: A 7.62 NATO caliber DMR originating from some ancient military supplier. It was modified using a close range kit.

rows.label: forsaken sniper rifle
rows.desc: This sniper rifle is prized by Forsaken explorers for its long range and high accuracy.

rows.label: heavy laser
rows.desc: A heavy-duty energy weapon designed to unleash a searing beam of focused light upon its targets that can slice through even the toughest armor.

rows.label: laser rifle
rows.desc:
An ultratech rifle capable of emitting a concentrated beam of light with enough power to deal considerable damage over medium distance.

By using advanced battery cells, this weapon is capable of warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.

rows.label: graviton lance
rows.desc:
"Think of space-time as a tapestry on a loom. This weapon is the needle."

The second shot in a burst from this weapon tears through space, dealing extra damage.

rows.label: pump shotgun
rows.desc: An ancient design of shotgun that emits a tight-packed spray of pellets. Deadly, but short range.

rows.label: Huge Javelin
rows.desc:
These huge javelins are primarily made for throwing, but they also make for acceptable melee weapons. They take a long time to throw, but one hit can do devastating damage. They are exceptionally bad at penetrating heavy armour. 

Can be wielded by giant, herculean, or warcasket pawns.

rows.label: Hunter's rifle
rows.desc: A Civil .308 single shot hunting rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It is powerful but has very little ammunition capacity.

rows.label: Makarov pistol
rows.desc: A small semi-automatic pistol originating from some ancient military supplier.

rows.label: coil lance
rows.desc: A mechanoid lance that electromagnetically accelerates piercing metal shards to enormous speeds.

rows.label: civilian rifle
rows.desc: A semi-automatic high-precision civilian AR rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. It uses special air pointed bullets and has a strong stopping effect.

rows.label: laser pistol
rows.desc:
An ultratech pistol capable of emitting a concentrated beam of light with enough power to deal considerable damage.

By using advanced battery cells, this weapon is capable of warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.

rows.label: DMR
rows.desc: A semi-automatic DMR produced by an ancient company named Remington. It has high shooting accuracy.

rows.label: forsaken assault rifle
rows.desc: This Forsaken assault rifle has a rather small calibre cartridge and a long reload time, but has a high burst shot count, high armor penetration and decent accuracy.

rows.label: charge sniper rifle
rows.desc: A specialized, high-velocity charge rifle designed for extreme-range engagement with anti-armor capabilities. It channels immense pulse-charge energy into a single, kinetic slug, delivering extremely high damage and armor penetration with pinpoint accuracy at maximum distance. Its bulk requires a stable firing position.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 7.7; cuts armour

rows.label: unique charge sniper rifle
rows.desc: A charge sniper rifle with customized parts.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 7.7; cuts armour

rows.label: autopistol
rows.desc: An ancient pattern blowback-operated self-loading pistol. It lacks stopping power and range, but is quick to fire.

rows.label: grav rifle
rows.desc: A heavy sniper weapon that firing gravitonium bullets. High attack range and damage, but low cooldown rate. It has a special long-range shooting ability.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 7.3; cuts armour

rows.label: military turret gun
rows.desc: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.

rows.desc:
An ultratech sniper rifle capable of emitting a concentrated beam of light with enough power to deal considerable damage over long range.

By using advanced battery cells, this weapon is capable of warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 7.1; cuts armour

rows.label: charge lance
rows.desc: A pulse-charged rail-assisted lance weapon. It fires a single shot at high velocity, charging it with unstable energy as it leaves the acceleration rail.

rows.label: unique charge lance
rows.desc: A charge lance with customized parts.

rows.label: cryptobolter
rows.desc: A high-tech crossbow rifle that fires cryogenic-coated bolts with devastating impact. On penetration, the bolts inflict deep frostburns, flash-freezing flesh and lacing wounds with cryptofreeze, drastically slowing movement and causing severe hypothermic damage over time.

rows.label: lever-action rifle
rows.desc: A traditional hunting rifle utilizing a lever-action mechanism. It offers a balance of moderate firepower, decent accuracy, and a fast follow-up shot compared to bolt-action designs, making it a reliable weapon for medium-range engagements.

rows.label: unique lever-action rifle
rows.desc: A lever-action rifle with customized parts.

rows.label: heavy revolver
rows.desc: A massive, high-caliber revolver, designed to deliver a devastating single punch. Its heavy frame and long barrel manage the immense recoil, making it slow to draw but highly effective at putting down targets with its powerful, armor-piercing rounds.

rows.label: unique heavy revolver
rows.desc: A heavy revolver with customized parts.

rows.label: revolver
rows.desc: An ancient pattern double-action revolver. It's not very powerful, but has a decent range for a pistol and is quick on the draw.

rows.label: unique revolver
rows.desc: A revolver with customized parts.

rows.label: marksman rifle
rows.desc: A specialized, semi-automatic rifle. It fires a powerful round with higher velocity than a standard assault rifle, offering an excellent balance of long-range precision and a faster rate of follow-up shots.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 6.3

rows.label: unique marksman rifle
rows.desc: A marksman rifle with customized parts.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 6.3

rows.label: charge blaster turret
rows.desc: A small charge blaster designed for use on a defense turret.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 6.0; turret mount only

rows.label: throwing knives
rows.desc: A small bundle of light, balanced knives designed to be thrown rapidly. Ineffective against armor, but capable of high close-range damage.

rows.label: anti-materiel rifle
rows.desc: Devastating, heavy-caliber bolt-action rifle designed to engage fortified positions and armored targets. It fires an exceptionally large round for superior damage and penetration at extreme ranges. Due to its weight and recoil, it's physically demanding and requires a long aiming period before it can be accurately fired.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.7; cuts armour

rows.label: unique anti-materiel rifle
rows.desc: An anti-materiel rifle with customized parts.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.7; cuts armour

rows.desc: An automatic shotgun made to be mounted on a turret.

rows.label: spiner
rows.desc: A very small gun used by war urchins which quickly fires spine-like projectiles. It is short-ranged but deadly.

rows.label: erianas vow
rows.desc:
"A light in the dark."

This weapon powerful armor-piercing bullets that can even pierce through shield belts.
rows.role: long-range single shot; DPS 5.7; cuts armour

rows.label: bolt-action rifle
rows.desc: An ancient pattern bolt-action rifle. With its long range, and low fire rate, it is unlikely to drive animals to revenge, which makes it a favorite weapon for hunting.

rows.label: unique bolt-action rifle
rows.desc: A bolt-action rifle with customized parts.

rows.label: modular hunting rifle
rows.desc: An ancient pattern bolt-action rifle. Its modification knowledges are widely known because of its long history.

rows.label: toxic needle gun
rows.desc: A mechanoid-built gun that fires toxin-infused metal needles. It can fire long distances and will poison the target in addition to doing physical damage.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.6

rows.label: custom sniper rifle
rows.desc: A specially customized M700 bolt action sniper rifle originating from some ancient military supplier. Has good accuracy and is light weight.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.6

rows.label: makeshift pistol
rows.desc: An improvised, rough, ancient-design pattern blowback-operated self-loading pistol. It lacks stopping power and range and is prone to jamming.

rows.label: Giant Bow
rows.desc: A huge bow capable of shooting arrows that put human javelins to shame. This weapon can only be wielded by giants.

rows.label: compound bow
rows.desc: A compact, sophisticated compound hunting bow. Its cam system stores high energy, providing superior accuracy and launching armor-piercing, high-velocity arrows. The reduced sound signature makes it ideal for stealthy hunting.

rows.label: unique compond bow
rows.desc: A compond bow with customized parts.

rows.label: semi-automatic rifle
rows.desc: A durable, self-loading rifle designed for rapid, controlled fire at medium-to-long ranges. Its mechanism allows for a high rate of fire compared to bolt-action models, making it ideal for maintaining continuous pressure on an enemy.

rows.label: unique semi-automatic rifle
rows.desc: A semi-automatic rifle with customized parts.

rows.label: Capryak Scatterbow
rows.desc: A rapid-firing bow crafted from the split horn of a Capryak and bound with Megabone fittings. Its flexible frame allows arrows to be loosed in quick succession, though its hurried shots rarely fly true at longer distances. Favored by tribal skirmishers and hunters who trust in speed over precision, it fills the air with horn-backed volleys before prey can react.

rows.label: scattergun
rows.desc: A compact short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a sentry drone.

rows.label: sniper rifle
rows.desc: An ancient design of precision sniper rifle. Bolt action. It has an exceptionally long range, great accuracy and good power. Because it's so unwieldy, other weapons outclass it at close range.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.0

rows.label: unique sniper rifle
rows.desc: A sniper rifle with customized parts.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.0

rows.label: rotary needle launcher
rows.desc: A versatile weapon that can fire a continuous stream of needle-like projectiles. Its rotating barrel allows for sustained fire, making it effective against swarms of enemies. Although it lacks the pinpoint accuracy of its single-shot counterpart, the rotary needle gun more than compensates with its high rate of fire and capacity for suppressing large areas.

rows.label: mini-turret gun
rows.desc: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.

rows.label: mini-turret gun
rows.desc: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.

rows.label: military turret gun
rows.desc: A refined automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.

rows.label: greatbow
rows.desc: A powerful greatbow. Fires a heavy arrow long distances.

rows.label: unique greatbow
rows.desc: A greatbow with customized parts.

rows.label: Verdant Bow
rows.desc: A masterwork bow crafted from the sacred wood of Deermoss and reinforced with Megabone and horns. Said to draw the breath of the forest into its string, each arrow hums with living vitality. The bow's horn tips make it a capable melee weapon against any approaching threat.

rows.label: recurve bow
rows.desc: A recurve bow. Its construction behaves like a tuned spring, storing energy more efficiently and delivering a faster shot.

rows.label: precision longrifle
rows.desc:
An advanced long-range sniper rifle. High caliber, high velocity bullets fly blindingly fast towards targets. The long range scope is only compatible with the eyes of people with the farsighted gene, and it allows the wielder to fire at extremely long ranges.n
\Due to the weapon's sheer size and weight, it is slow to aim and hard to move with when equipped.n
\The longrifle is employed by venator bounty hunters and assassins alike. In their hands, every shot hits. If you hear it, you weren't the target.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 4.5

rows.label: makeshift SMG
rows.desc: A small, home-made micro-submachine gun. It's short range and very prone to jamming due to the rough design and faulty elements. Its rate of fire tends to make up for its weakness.

rows.label: throwing rocks
rows.desc: A handful of rocks. Can inflict minor injuries in close range. Doesn't drop on death. Simple but effective.

rows.label: long metal pipe
rows.desc: A long metal pipe, for bashing enemies to death. This weapon is the big brother of the regular metal pipe and is currently the peak of human evolution. It's rather heavy, but the longer it gets, the harder it hits.

rows.label: makeshift rifle
rows.desc: A general-purpose gas-operated improvised assault rifle, utilising various salvaged components mounted on a militia rifle receiver. It has good range, decent power, and good accuracy, but is prone to jamming.

rows.label: longbow
rows.desc: A tall, powerful bow requiring great strength to draw. It launches high velocity arrows at extreme range.

rows.label: unique longbow
rows.desc: A longbow with customized parts.

rows.label: crossbow
rows.desc: A simple crossbow. It fires a standard bolt with decent accuracy and firing rate, making it a reliable mid-tier anti-armor ranged weapon.

rows.label: unique crossbow
rows.desc: A crossbow with customized parts.

rows.label: warcasket laser blaster
rows.desc: An enlarged laser weapon, combining both modern and antique methods into a compact package. Taking advantage of a greater weight tolerance, this system includes a revolver cylinder using advanced battery cells instead of cartridges. This allows the weapon to fire more powerful shots at a slower warmup reduction, meaning safer sustained fire for the operator.
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 3.8; cuts armour

rows.label: short bow
rows.desc: A simple short selfbow made from a single piece of wood.

rows.label: nerve spiker
rows.desc: A crossbow-like device that throws rough spikes embedded with a paralytic biotoxin. Low damage, but it stuns non-mechanoid targets. Large targets are more resistant to the biotoxin and will be stunned for less time.

rows.label: mini-shotgun
rows.desc: A compact, short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.

rows.label: pila
rows.desc: Pila are spears for throwing. They take a long time to throw, but one hit can do heavy damage. This weapon represents a bundle of pila and can be thrown over and over. The singular of pila is pilum.

rows.label: heavy crossbow
rows.desc:
A heavy crossbow has a similar principle to a bow, consisting of a bow-like assembly mounted horizontally on a sturdy frame, which is handheld in a similar fashion to the stock of a long gun.

This heavy bolt thrower fires devastating bolts, capable of piercing several layers of metal.

rows.label: makeshift revolver
rows.desc: A crude hammer-fired revolver that is very prone to jamming.

rows.label: goliath needle gun
rows.desc: A long-range weapon used by mechanoids. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. While it does less damage than charge weapons, it can reach over very long distances.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 3.3

rows.label: needle gun
rows.desc: A long-range weapon used by mechanoids. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. While it does less damage than charge weapons, it can reach over very long distances.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 3.3

rows.label: needle launcher
rows.desc: This mechanoid weapon is a compact version of the needle gun. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. The needle launcher has less range than its counterpart but is lightweight, allowing it to be wielded by fast-moving mechs.

rows.label: valved metal pipe
rows.desc: A short metal pipe with a valve, for bashing enemies to death. This weapon is presumed to be the next step in human evolution after a regular metal pipe. The valve attached to this pipe allows to control the flow of various fluids, such as water, sewage and blood of your enemies.

rows.label: metal pipe
rows.desc: A short metal pipe, for bashing enemies to death. This weapon is part of human biology. Evolutionary biologists say that a major reason humans have wrists is to be able to swing a metal pipe.

rows.label: slugthrower
rows.desc: A compact single-shot slug thrower designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.

rows.label: dribbling cap poison dart
rows.desc: This small poison dart has been filled with the pungent resin flowing from a dribbling cap fungus. It is an extremely potent neurotoxin, causing immediate paralysis, and eventually, death.
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 2.4; one use then gone

rows.label: mini-blaster
rows.desc: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a wardrone.

rows.label: thornspitter
rows.desc: A tiny mound serving as the entrance to an expansive deephive cluster below ground, topped by the emergence of a thornspitter insectoid. This creature is capable of ejecting inaccurate chitin thorns at enemies close-by, provided it is regularly fed with insect jelly. If starved, the mound will gradually deteriorate. Once completely deteriorated, the thornworm will retreat back into the deephive tunnels.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 2.3; turret mount only

rows.label: makeshift LMG
rows.desc: An improvised, gas-operated light machine gun. Unwieldy and inaccurate, it is also very prone to jamming. Its long bursts of fire are effective against groups of enemies, but their shot counts are completely random.

rows.label: throwspikes
rows.desc: Throwspikes are short sticks sharpened on both sides. They take a while to throw, but can do reasonable damage when they hit. This weapon represents a bundle of throwspikes and can be thrown over and over.

rows.label: flamebow
rows.desc: A simple short selfbow with a load of incendiary arrows. The arrows carry fuel and an igniter. Upon impact, they spray fuel around and ignite it.

rows.label: makeshift shotgun
rows.desc: An improvised design powerful shotgun that emits a large barrage of pellets. Deadly, but short range. Due to numerous faults in design, the amount of pellets fired varies shot by shot.

rows.label: mini needle gun
rows.desc: A long-range weapon used by artillerons. Shoots with great accuracy over very long distances, but does very little damage.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 1.3

rows.label: foam belcher
rows.desc: An organic, firefoam pod produced by giant insects. When it senses fire, the pod sprays a fire-retardant foam in a cone. Contrary to basic foam pods it won't be destroyed after some time, but needs to be built on the creep. Needs insect jelly to work.

rows.label: Mira's Hold Out Repeater
rows.desc:
Possession of this heavily-modified blaster would be a Class I felony in over 800 different star systems. Thankfully, even the most backwater law enforcement officers know better than to try and take them from the galaxy's greatest bounty hunter.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: micro-repeating blaster
rows.desc: Repeating blasters of this size are strictly outlawed in just about every civilized part of the galaxy. It's not about the combat effectiveness, it's about the terror-inducing aspects.

rows.label: Mandalorian Micro-Repeater
rows.desc:
The preferred weapon of Mandalorian front-line troops, this compact blaster has the firepower and spread necessary to make an absolute mess of a tight trench or an enclosed room, with little care to who gets caught in the crossfire.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Nar Shaddaa Grinder
rows.desc:
On the mean streets of Nar Shaddaa, a blaster like this can be the difference between life and death.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Trigger

rows.label: Trandoshan Chopper
rows.desc:
Manufactured by Arakyd Industries specifically for Trandoshan special forces mercenaries, this lightweight repeater is a must-have for close-quarters combat.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Westar-M5 Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: They were mainly used by the Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commandos during the later years of the conflict.

rows.label: dlt-19 heavy blaster rifle
rows.desc: The DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle was a model of heavy blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries. They were used by regular stormtroopers and Heavy Weapons Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire, but they also saw use by other parties, including the Alliance to Restore the Republic and certain bounty hunters.

rows.label: t-21 repeating blaster
rows.desc: The T-21 light repeating blaster, also known as the T-21 heavy blaster or simply the T-21 blaster rifle, was a model of light repeating blaster manufactured by BlasTech Industries.

rows.label: tl-50 heavy repeater
rows.desc: The TL-50 Heavy Repeater was a model of heavy repeating blaster rifle that was manufactured for the special forces of the Galactic Empire. In addition to sending storms of blaster bolts from its multiple barrels, the rifle could gather its energy into a powerful concussion blast. It could also be modified with an extended barrel for reduced spread and with a power cell for increased cooling power.

rows.label: e-22 blaster rifle
rows.desc: The E-22 reciprocating double-barreled blaster rifle, also known as the E-22 blaster rifle, was a reciprocating, double-barreled blaster that was bigger and more powerful than the standard E-11 medium blaster rifle used by the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers.

rows.label: repeating blaster carbine
rows.desc: This weapon allows the user to fire more quickly than usual, increasing his chances of survival without drastically changing the amount of equipment they would normally carry.

rows.label: Onderon Repeating Carbine
rows.desc: These weapons were employed by the elite troops of Iziz during the Battle of Onderon. The power of these carbines, combined with their high rate of fire, was believed to play a considerable role in the rout of the Mandalorian forces.

rows.label: twin wrist blaster
rows.desc: A droid wrist blaster, typically found on Destroyer Droids but not uncommon on other models when they've been modified.

rows.label: a280 blaster rifle
rows.desc: The A280 blaster rifle was a type of blaster rifle mostly used by troopers of the Rebel Alliance and the soldiers of the New Republic. There existed two variants of the A280 blaster, the A280C and the A280-CFE, both of which were favored by commandos of the Rebel Alliance.

rows.label: Z6 Rotary Blaster Cannon
rows.desc: The Z-6 rotary blaster cannon was a powerful rotating blaster cannon chaingun developed by Merr-Sonn Munitions.

rows.label: dh-17 blaster rifle
rows.desc: The DH-17 blaster pistol was a close-combat blaster pistol produced by BlasTech Industries. This however is a rifle. Totally different, I'm sure of it.

rows.label: ab-75 bo-rifle
rows.desc: he AB-75 bo-rifle was a model of bo-rifle manufactured by the Lasan-Malamut Firearms Corporation. Bo-rifles had a long tradition in the Lasat culture, and were used exclusively by the Lasan High Honor Guard.

rows.label: blaster carbine
rows.desc: A simple blaster carbine designed for civilian use. Commonly found throughout the galaxy in the hands of people who want to keep their land and their life.

rows.label: e-11 blaster rifle
rows.desc: The E-11 blaster rifle was a light but powerful blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries. It served as the standard issue weapon of Imperial stormtroopers. The blaster rifle was the successor to BlasTech's E-10 blaster rifle and was based on the DC-15A blaster carbine used by clone troopers during the Clone Wars.

rows.label: vss blaster carbine
rows.desc: An overdesigned blaster carbine design typically found in use by the Pyke Syndicate, or those they crossed and failed to deal with.

rows.label: dlt-20a blaster rifle
rows.desc: The DLT-20A blaster rifle, also known as the DLT-20A laser rifle, was a model of blaster rifle produced by BlasTech Industries. Members of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps sometimes used DLT-20As instead of their standard issue E-11 blaster rifles. IG-assassin droid IG-11 carried this model of rifle, without the scope attached. Another type of rifle, the pulse cannon, utilized the frame assembly of a DLT-20A.

rows.label: DC-15S Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: Smaller in scale than the DC-15A blaster rifle, the DC-15S blaster lacked its larger cousin's range, but was easier to handle than its bulkier cousin with a higher rate of fire.

rows.label: DC-17M Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: The DC-17M blaster with a higher rate of fire.

rows.label: heavy repeating blaster
rows.desc: This weapon again increases the firepower available to the foot soldier or mercenary, but it is not for the lightly armored who wish to be quick on their feet.

rows.label: Baragwin Heavy Repeating Blaster
rows.desc:
A heavier version of the Baragwin Assault Gun, this weapon features similar improvements over its more common version. The incredible amounts of energy contained in the beam can be upgraded even further to produce a blast capable of setting even durasteel on fire for brief periods.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: Mandalorian Heavy Repeater
rows.desc:
With this weapon, the Mandalorians again demonstrate a complete lack of subtlety. The only thing better than a big blaster, apparently, is one that shoots faster.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Ordo's Repeating Blaster
rows.desc:
This prototype heavy repeater was developed during the latter part of the Mandalorian War and never saw general production.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: light repeating blaster
rows.desc: This weapon allows the user to fire more quickly than usual, increasing their chances of survival without drastically changing the amount of equipment they would normally carry.

rows.label: Baragwin Assault Gun
rows.desc:
This light repeating blaster is an excellent example of the Baragwin aptitude for weaponry. By taking and modifying an existing repeating blaster design, the Baragwin have managed to greatly increase the damage output and added additional functionality with a variety of upgrade options.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Combat Enforcer
rows.desc:
This powerful repeating blaster inflicts incredible pain and damage upon its victim, but is difficult to use effectively. Its origin is unclear, though there are some similarities to its design and that of Mandalorian weapons.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Mandalore's Assault Rifle
rows.desc:
A repeating blaster supposedly used by Mandalore the Ultimate himself. It is unknown how it survived the apocalyptic Battle of Malachor V and found its way onto this lowly rim world.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: medium repeating blaster
rows.desc:
Weapons such as this are not usually available for public purchase. They are best utilized during quick troop deployment and other situations where rapid suppressing fire is required.

UPGRADE SLOTS:

- Trigger

rows.label: wrist blaster
rows.desc: A droid wrist blaster, typically found on B2 Super Battle Droids but not uncommon on other models when they've been modified.

rows.label: p-tower
rows.desc: A self-loading large-bore cannon designed to attach to a turret.

rows.label: Westar-44 Heavy Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: The WESTAR-44 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

rows.label: blaster pistol
rows.desc: The most common ranged weapon in the galaxy is the basic blaster pistol, firing a bolt of intense coherent light powered by a replaceable power pack.

rows.label: Arkanian Pistol
rows.desc: This is a versatile blaster variant, possibly of ancient Arkanian origin. The Arkanians are very proud that such early efforts continue to be prized among collectors and soldiers.

rows.label: Bendak's Blaster
rows.desc:
This blaster belonged to Bendak Starkiller, a duelist legendary on Taris. It is a highly adaptable weapon, and is definitely of better quality than any standard issue pistol.

- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: GenoHaradan Blaster
rows.desc:
The GenoHaradan created this blaster as a tool to strike against well-protected assassination targets. It's remarkable accuracy makes it the perfect weapon for precision, long range strikes.

rows.label: Mandalorian Blaster
rows.desc:
The Mandalorian Blaster is a slightly more powerful version of the basic pistol common throughout the galaxy.

UPGRADE SLOTS:

- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Micro-Pulse Blaster
rows.desc:
Built of durable thoranium, this blaster is able to fire more intense pulses of energy than lesser pistols are capable of. The result is the potency of an advanced blaster rifle in a one-handed weapon.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Onasi Blaster
rows.desc:
This blaster bears the symbol of the Onasi family. It perhaps once belonged to Carth Onasi, a former companion of Revan.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Republic Blaster
rows.desc:
The Republic Blaster can be upgraded with firing chambers and targeting scopes.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: blaster carbine
rows.desc: Created initially by Gungis X Weapons, blaster carbine rifles have become very popular in recent years, helped by falling prices due to competition from other companies.

rows.label: Cinnagaran Carbine
rows.desc:
This blaster rifle variant is one of many fine weapons produced by the factories of Cinnagar in their continued militarizing after the Great Hyperspace War a thousand years ago.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Jamoh Hogra's Carbine
rows.desc:
This was the weapon of mercenary Jamoh Hogra, and was supposed to protect him against the many enemies he earned in his lifetime. Hogra's skill didn't match its potential, however.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Jurgan Kalta's Carbine
rows.desc:
The Zabrak mercenary Jurgan Kalta commissioned this rifle, a weapon he liked to think of as "amusingly destructive."

- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Commando Special Carbine
rows.desc:
The "Special" is a variant of the basic blaster carbine preferred by Republic commando units. Highly adaptable, its design allows for easy modification to fit any scenario.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: Sith Assault Gun
rows.desc:
This is a modification on the blaster carbine rarely seen outside of Sith-controlled space.

UPGRADE SLOTS:

- Firing Chamber

rows.label: e-10 blaster rifle
rows.desc: The E-10 blaster rifle was a model of blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries used by Imperial Army troopers and Imperial Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire. It was equipped with a glow rod for low-light vision.

rows.label: AQ Battle Blaster
rows.desc: built-in blaster cannons for AQ battle Droid

rows.label: Droideka Long Blaster
rows.desc: Long Blaster made for the Droideka sniper

rows.label: Droidekas Blaster
rows.desc: Two twin built-in blaster cannons

rows.label: LR-57 Combat Blaster
rows.desc: In-build blaster for LR-57 Droid

rows.label: e-11d blaster rifle
rows.desc: The E-11 blaster rifle was a light but powerful blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries. It served as the standard issue weapon of Imperial stormtroopers. The blaster rifle was the successor to BlasTech's E-10 blaster rifle and was based on the DC-15A blaster carbine used by clone troopers during the Clone Wars.

rows.label: heavy blaster
rows.desc: These resemble regular blasters in the same way Quoorian marshsuckers resemble mosquitoes. Sure, they both do damage, but the former definitely has the edge in kill-potential.

rows.label: Arkanian Heavy Pistol
rows.desc: Arkanian designs of this kind predated mass acceptance of heavier pistols, but 2000 years later they are still superior performers. Unfortunately, their design is incompatible with modern upgrade technology.

rows.label: Cassus Fett's Heavy Pistol
rows.desc:
Cassus Fett was rarely seen without this adaptable blaster. Famous for killing the captain of a flagship Republic frigate at the Battle of Jaga's Cluster, he is presumed dead.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Mandalorian Heavy Blaster
rows.desc:
Mandalorians boast that a shot from one of these pistols can take a starship out of commission. It's an obvious exaggeration, but for safety's sake, most listeners just smile and nod.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Freedon Nadd's Blaster
rows.desc:
A vile weapon that once belonged to Freedon Nadd, this blaster has killed more Jedi then any lightsaber.

- Scope

rows.label: Zabrak Heavy Blaster
rows.desc:
A more cumbersome, but also more damaging, blaster of Zabrak design.

- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Zabrak Tystel Mark III
rows.desc:
The Zabrak killed many pirates who were attempting to seize shipments of these weapons and then sold them on the black market anyway. It's not a matter of where they end up, but of who gets paid.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: DC-15A Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: The DC-15A blaster rifle was one of the standard issue weapons for clone troopers. While the use of blasters allowed a clone trooper to carry significantly more ammunition than a projectile weapon.

rows.label: M-56 Heavy Blaster Cannon
rows.desc: The M-56 Heavy Blaster Cannon is a powerful weapon used in the Star Wars universe. It is a heavy-duty blaster that fires concentrated bolts of energy and is capable of causing significant damage to its target. The M-56 is often mounted on vehicles, such as speeder bikes or starfighters, and can also be carried and used by infantry soldiers. It has a high rate of fire and a large ammo capacity, making it a formidable weapon on the battlefield. Despite its destructive capabilities, the M-56 is difficult to handle due to its size and weight, requiring a strong and skilled operator to use it effectively.

rows.label: SE-14 Light Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: The SE-14 was used by the B1-Series battle droids of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars and was referred to as the Separatist blaster pistol.

rows.label: blaster rifle
rows.desc: More powerful than the commonly available pistol, the blaster rifle is favored by soldiers throughout the galaxy. Civilian ownership of these weapons is not generally encouraged.

rows.label: Arkanian Blaster Rifle
rows.desc:
The Arkanian Blaster Rifle's ancient design is still quite powerful by modern standards. However, they cannot be outfitted with modern firing chambers and power cells, limiting them to scopes for upgrade options.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: Watchman Rifle
rows.desc:
A solid, reliable weapon of Republic origin, this rifle is designed with modularity first and foremost.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Jurgan Kalta's Assault Rifle
rows.desc:
Jurgan Kalta wanteed to make a big noise in the galaxy. If it was the screams of his enemies, all the better. This weapon was his favorite because it shared his adaptability.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: Mandalorian Assault Rifle
rows.desc:
These weapons are almost overpowered for their size, but the Mandalorians prefer them that way. They do not make a habit of being subtle in their war making.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Plasma Projector
rows.desc: This massive weapon fires a bolt of plasma energy at its target. Difficult to wield except by highly trained marksmen, the plasma projector is also unsuitable for further upgrades.

rows.label: Zersium Rifle
rows.desc:
This rifle is made in part of Zersium, a rare mineral that aids in energy dissipation. This characteristic allows the rifle to utilize more powerful energy bursts without risking the safety of its wielder.

rows.label: blaster cannon
rows.desc: A droid blaster cannon, typically found on B2 Super Battle Droids but not uncommon on other models when they've been modified.

rows.label: DC-17S Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: Like all blasters of the DC-line manufactured by BlasTech Industries. Base on the DC-17 Blaster pistol with an extender.

rows.label: DC-17 Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: Like all blasters of the DC-line manufactured by BlasTech Industries, the DC-17 hand blaster fired blue plasma projectiles that were hyper-ionized to be especially devastating against droids while retaining its lethality against organic beings.

rows.label: Zabrak Battle Cannon
rows.desc:
These weapons are almost beginning to cross the line to light artillery. Armor is generally ineffective against such a weapon, unless it is of the highest quality.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: EE-3 Carbine Rifle
rows.desc: It was an optically fitted blaster rifle capable of three-round burst fire at long ranges, but had lower accuracy and stopping power compared to larger rifles

rows.label: E-5C Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: The E-5C blaster rifle was manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop on order from the Trade Federation for their Droid Army.

rows.label: E-5 Blaster Rifle
rows.desc: The E-5 blaster rifle was manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop on order from the Trade Federation for their Droid Army.

rows.label: Westar-33 Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: The Westar-33 is a blaster pistol used in Star Wars that fires energy bolts and is popular among soldiers and bounty hunters. It has a moderate rate of fire and small ammo capacity, but is reliable and durable.

rows.label: Westar-34 Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: The WESTAR-34 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

rows.label: Westar-35 Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: The WESTAR-35 blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.

rows.label: Ceremonial Bowcaster
rows.desc: This specialized bowcaster was designed for use in ceremonial hunts. It is capable of an impressive rate of fire even in unskilled hands. Though not suitable for upgrading, few of the weapon's targets would argue that further enhancement is necessary.

rows.label: Bowcaster
rows.desc: The bowcaster is an invention of the Wookiees of Kashyyyk. Also called a laser crossbow, it actually uses a magnetic accelerator to hurl an explosive energy quarrel at its target.

rows.label: Mercenary Bowcaster
rows.desc:
A derivative of traditional Wookiee Bowcaster designs manufactured and sold by Czerka Corporation for use by other humanoids. Most Wookiees would likely not appreciate such outside influence.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: War Bowcaster
rows.desc:
The bowcaster is an invention of the Wookiees of Kashyyyk. Also called a laser crossbow, it actually uses a magnetic accelerator to hurl an explosive energy quarrel at its target. This more expensive war bowcaster is suitable for upgrading.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Zaalbar's Bowcaster
rows.desc:
This is Zaalbar's personal bowcaster. He has made modifications to it over the years, but it still tightly conforms to the traditions of his people.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: E-5S Sniper Rifle
rows.desc: The E-5s sniper rifle was a 4-shot rifle produced by Baktoid Armor Workshop and used by the Battle droid assassins of the Trade Federation and the Separatist Droid Army.

rows.label: a180 blaster pistol
rows.desc:
The A-180 blaster was a modular blaster manufactured by BlasTech Industries. It was a highly versatile design which could be easily reconfigured into a blaster rifle, sniper rifle, or ion launcher depending on the situation.

Note: The actual functionality would make it wildly OP, so it functions only as a pistol.

rows.label: de-10 blaster
rows.desc: The DE-10 blaster pistol is a stylish and reliable heavy blaster pistol that is manufactured by Antrech Arms, a subsidiary of BlasTech Industries. It is vaunted for its reliability and ease of maintenance, and heavily resembled a slugthrower revolver.

rows.label: dh-17 blaster pistol
rows.desc: The DH-17 blaster pistol was a close-combat blaster pistol produced by BlasTech Industries.

rows.label: k-16 bryar blaster
rows.desc: Deceptive by design, the K-16 appeared to be a regular blaster pistol; however, it featured a modified power unit capable of releasing its entire heat source in one powerful blast as secondary fire.

rows.label: ion LMG
rows.desc: A chainsaw grip rail LMG of spacer make designed for hip firing, developed during mechanoid wars to counter the rampaging warmachines. Reliable and easy to operate, it launches a barrage of small tungsten spikes at supersonic speed, penetrating deep into even the thickest plasteel carapace to deliver a payload of ionizing particles. The particles, once sufficiently built up, release in an electromagnetic pulse, breaking energy shields and stunning any mechanoid caught in the radius.

rows.label: barm-st12 scattergun
rows.desc: The BARM-ST12 scattergun was a type of pump-action scatterblaster, the blaster equivalent of a shotgun.

rows.label: dg-29 heavy blaster
rows.desc: The DG-29 heavy blaster pistol, also known as the DG-29 sideloader, is a model of heavy blaster pistol produced by BlasTech Industries,

rows.label: dlt-19x targeting blaster
rows.desc: The DLT-19x targeting blaster was a blaster rifle, and a variation of the DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle. Unlike the DLT-19, the DLT-19x released all of its power in one shot before it would need to cool down. The DLT-19x was an incredibly powerful weapon, and could take down most enemies in one shot. The weapon had a scope which could be zoomed in farther than most scopes. This targeting blaster was silent and effective, and as such, was a weapon of choice for many snipers, and the primary weapon for some Imperial sharpshooters. The LOM-series bounty hunter 4-LOM also wielded a DLT-19x.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 12.2

rows.label: B2-HA Super Droid Wrist Cannon
rows.desc: Built-in Snigle blaster cannon.

rows.label: ion rifle
rows.desc: A lightweight rail rifle of spacer make, developed during mechanoid wars to counter the rampaging warmachines. Reliable and easy to operate, it launches a series of small tungsten spikes at supersonic speed, penetrating deep into even the thickest plasteel carapace to deliver a payload of ionizing particles. The particles, once sufficiently built up, release in an electromagnetic pulse, breaking energy shields and stunning any mechanoid caught in the radius.

rows.label: Luxa's Modified Disruptor
rows.desc: This heavily modified disruptor pistol was used by Luxa, a renowned Exchange captain under the Telosian crime boss Loppak Slusk. Luxa was rumored to have been killed after attempting to double-cross both Loppak and a Jedi, though some sources claim she survived and has resurfaced as a bounty hunter on Ord Mantell.

rows.label: Zabrak Blaster Pistol
rows.desc: This blaster is the staple of the Zabrak mercenary, known for deadly accuracy and exceptional damage.

rows.label: Zabrak Blaster Carbine
rows.desc: The design of the Zabrak Blaster Carbine is too complicated to allow further upgrading. Fortunately, it has little need for additional enhancement.

rows.label: Sith Officer Pistol
rows.desc:
These weapons are designed to incapacitate so death may be quick or lingered upon as desired. Droids are simply dispatched, as cruelty is best rationed among the living. This is a special upgraded model, offered only to the highest-ranking Sith.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: salvaged laser shotgun
rows.desc:
A salvaged scattergun capable of emitting several unstable beams of light with enough power to deal moderate damage.

By using makeshift battery cells, this weapon is capable of quickly warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat quickly when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.

rows.label: ion PDW
rows.desc: A lightweight rail PDW of spacer make, developed during mechanoid wars to counter the rampaging warmachines. Reliable and easy to operate, it launches a series of tiny tungsten spikes at supersonic speed, penetrating deep into even the thickest plasteel carapace to deliver a payload of ionizing particles. The particles, once sufficiently built up, release in an electromagnetic pulse, breaking energy shields and stunning any mechanoid caught in the radius.

rows.label: ion slugthrower
rows.desc: A lightweight rail slugthrower of spacer make, developed during mechanoid wars to counter the rampaging warmachines. Reliable and easy to operate, it launches a spike-tipped tungsten slug at supersonic speed, penetrating deep into even the thickest plasteel carapace to deliver a payload of ionizing particles. The particles, once sufficiently built up, release in an electromagnetic pulse, breaking energy shields and stunning any mechanoid caught in the radius.
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 9.4; cuts armour

rows.label: beam repeater turret
rows.desc: An ultratech weapon that emits gamma ray laser bursts in a rapid sequence. The tight gamma beams can pierce shields.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: mid-range, 8-round burst; DPS 9.2; turret mount only; cuts armour

rows.label: growth-ray mini-turret gun
rows.desc: A simple automatic growth-ray made to be mounted on a turret.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 8.5; turret mount only

rows.label: shrink-ray mini-turret gun
rows.desc: A simple automatic shrink-ray made to be mounted on a turret.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 8.5; turret mount only

rows.label: growth ray
rows.desc:
A ray for growing things. Not in the botanical sense.

Hopefully this iteration will not create man-eating turnips if the botany team get them mixed up again. 

Note: Overloading the subject after growth has stopped can lead do a dangerous discharge of growth flux and the subject suffers a form micro-disintegration that has killed all machines and life-forms we've tested it on.

This weapon afflicts no direct damage.

rows.label: shrink ray
rows.desc:
A ray for shrinking. Use with caution since very small objects get quantum unstable and can fall into other dimensions.

Note: try not to mix up to be confused with the other "shrink ray" made to restore mental health; no need to shrink our customer approval.

This weapon afflicts no direct damage.

rows.label: Jawa Ion Striker
rows.desc:
Small but dangerous, these ion pistols are a true testament to the ingenuity of Jawas. Excessively modular, each one is hand crafted by a professional Jawa weaponsmith, resulting in a truly unique blaster.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter
- Trigger

rows.label: ion blaster
rows.desc: Unlike a typical blaster, this weapon fires a stream of energy very damaging to electrical systems, causing havoc on the internal components of droids.

rows.label: Aratech Ionmaster
rows.desc:
This capable side-arm is at the top of Aratech's ion blaster line. It is designed for multi-purpose use, though obviously is best against droids.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Verpine Prototype Ion Blaster
rows.desc:
Demonstrating this weapon, the insect-like Verpine destroyed legions of droids, doing nothing to quell the public's suspicions of what testing their stun guns must have been like.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: ion carbine
rows.desc: Ion Carbines are versatile, low-end rifles. They are sometimes given to combat droids to provide an edge against other droid armies.

rows.label: sonic pistol
rows.desc: Sometimes referred to as "squealers", these weapons deliver a high-frequency jolt to the senses that can damage and potentially disorient an opponent.

rows.label: Arkanian Sonic Blaster
rows.desc: This sonic pistol of Arkanian design is as potent as a normal blaster, but with the many benefits of dealing sonic damage.

rows.label: Bothan Shrieker
rows.desc:
This is an improvement over the standard sonic pistol design that must seem doubly shrill to the large ears of the Bothans.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: Dashade Sonic Disruptor
rows.desc:
The Dashade are a secretive and vicious species made infamous by their renowned assassins. Their weapons of choice are best known for the extreme pain they inflict. This improved model combines the best features of sonic and disruptor pistols.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: Heavy Sonic Blaster
rows.desc:
This incredibly debilitating weapon is of unknown origin. Unlike most lesser models, it can be fitted with a chamber upgrade.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: salvaged laser pistol
rows.desc:
A salvaged pistol capable of emitting an unstable beam of light with enough power to deal moderate damage.

By using makeshift battery cells, this weapon is capable of quickly warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat quickly when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.

rows.label: disruptor carbine
rows.desc: This disruptor is even more destructive than its pistol counterpart, and is outlawed on just as many worlds. Disruptors reduce solid matter to its constituent molecules. Painfully.

rows.label: sonic carbine
rows.desc: More powerful than the pistol, the sonic carbine fires a blast of sound that causes a great deal of sensory overload in addition to damage, disorienting the victim.

rows.label: Nagai Sonic Disruptor
rows.desc:
Combining both sonic and disruptor attacks, this carbine tears through enemy defenses.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: ec-17 scout blaster
rows.desc: The EC-17 hold-out blaster, also known as the scout pistol, flash pistol, or scout trooper blaster, was a standard-issue hold-out blaster pistol for Imperial scout troopers and patrol troopers, manufactured by BlasTech Industries.

rows.label: se-14r blaster
rows.desc: The SE-14r light repeating blaster, also known as the SE-14r blaster pistol, the SE-14r blaster rifle, or simply the SE-14 pistol, was a light repeating blaster manufactured by BlasTech Industries designed to be disassembled and fitted with a scope. Greatly resembling the SE-14C blaster pistol, it was used by personnel of the Galactic Empire, including the Imperial Intelligence's death troopers, regular stormtroopers, and some officers.

rows.label: flame turret gun
rows.desc: A flamethrower made to be mounted on a turret.
rows.dpsNote: this is the GUN's own cooldown; a turret building carrying it may override the rate with turretBurstCooldownTime
rows.role: mid-range single shot; DPS 6.6; turret mount only

rows.label: siegemelter flamethrower
rows.desc: A gigantic flamethrower mounted on top of a siegebreaker chassis. Its fire reaches incredibly high temperatures.

rows.label: acid spewer
rows.desc: A devastating weapon designed to unleash a torrent of acidic sludge upon its targets. Equipped with advanced chemical reservoirs and spraying mechanisms, it is capable of spraying a wide area with a potent acid that can dissolve even the most durable materials.

rows.label: ion rifle
rows.desc: Any well-stocked militia usually has stores of ion rifles in reserve. They aren't much use against the living, but if the enemy has battle droids these weapons become essential.

rows.label: Baragwin Ion-X Weapon
rows.desc:
This weapon is an experimental Baragwin design that has been extensively modified by Suvam Tan. He has incorporated what he describes as a 'shaped-energy' delivery system into the weapon, which allows it to deliver concussive force on impact in addition to the weapon's normal energy discharge. Upgrades to the weapon could potentially greatly increase both its impact force and its penetration.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Bothan Droid Disruptor
rows.desc:
Droids can be difficult obstacles for a spy, but these weapons take all the guesswork out of dealing with them.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Verpine Droid Disintegrator
rows.desc:
While they may have borrowed liberally from designs the Bothans initiated, the Verpine say you can't argue with results. These weapons are simply devastating against droids.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: disruptor Pistol
rows.desc: These pistols are illegal in many planetary systems, being regarded as too powerful a weapon to be owned by civilians. Disruptors reduce solid matter to its constituent molecules. Unlike typical blasters, disruptors ignore most types of personal energy shields.

rows.label: Mandalorian Disintegrator
rows.desc:
Not surprisingly, the most deadly disruptor pistol available is of Mandalorian design. Use of this ruthless weapon is a major violation of Republic code.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

rows.label: Mandalorian Ripper
rows.desc:
A weapon similar to this disruptor belonged to Jigger Wraith, a bounty hunter who plagued the Republic years ago. Thirty-seven Mandalorians were executed for being him until sightings declined.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Sith Disruptor
rows.desc:
The Sith disruptor design is compatible with most types of standard blaster upgrades.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: salvaged laser sniper rifle
rows.desc:
A salvaged sniper rifle capable of emitting an unstable beam of light with enough power to deal moderate damage over long distances.

By using makeshift battery cells, this weapon is capable of quickly warming up, boosting the firing speed with each consecutive shot when standing still.

This weapon can overheat quickly when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.
rows.role: long-range single shot; DPS 5.7; cuts armour

rows.label: sonic rifle
rows.desc: More powerful than the pistol, the sonic rifle fires a blast of sound that causes a great deal of sensory overload in addition to damage, disorienting the victim.

rows.label: Argazdan Riot Buster
rows.desc:
During the Argazdan's subjugation of the Lorrdians, non-lethal technology was a profitable commodity. The Argazdan Riot Buster knocks its target to the ground and stuns them.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: Arkanian Sonic Rifle
rows.desc:
The Arkanians pioneered many non-lethal weapons that could disorient opponents, but most were retrofitted to be superior damage dealers as well because the initial demand for them was so low.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: Bothan Discord Gun
rows.desc:
This was conceived as a "last resort" weapon should espionage fail and a quick retreat be called for. It is effective, but the Bothans would prefer that it not be needed.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope

rows.label: ion DMR
rows.desc: A lightweight rail DMR of spacer make, developed during mechanoid wars to counter the rampaging warmachines. Reliable and easy to operate, it launches a tungsten spike at supersonic speed, penetrating deep into even the thickest plasteel carapace to deliver a payload of ionizing particles. The particles, once sufficiently built up, release in an electromagnetic pulse, breaking energy shields and stunning any mechanoid caught in the radius.
rows.role: long-range single shot; DPS 5.5; cuts armour

rows.label: disruptor rifle
rows.desc: This disruptor is even more destructive than its pistol counterpart, and is outlawed on just as many worlds. Disruptors reduce solid matter to its constituent molecules. Painfully.

rows.label: Baragwin Disruptor-X Weapon
rows.desc:
Using the same 'shaped-energy' concept as in his Ion-X Weapon, Suvam Tan has modified a Baragwin disruptor weapon as well, giving comparable levels of concussive force to the blast that the Ion-X Weapon delivers.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Charric
rows.desc:
The Charric is an immensely powerful disruptor rifle. Exceedingly rare, its origin is believed to be somewhere in the Unknown Regions, though what species created it is unknown. The Charric employs maser beams and easily penetrates most armor and shields.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: HK-47's Assassin Rifle
rows.desc:
This disruptor has all the modifications an assassin droid needs: improved optics, reduced recoil, extended range, and several open ports for even more modular upgrades.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.label: Tenloss Disruptor Rifle
rows.desc:
Manufactured by the elusive Tenloss Syndicate, these dangerous and highly-illegal rifles present a level of modularity not commonly seen amongst weapons of this class. Amusingly, the Eriadu Authority's bounty on these rifles was worth significantly more than the manufacturer's original selling price, leading to years of fraudulent buybacks thanks to several well-paid smugglers and well-bribed Authority officials.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Scope
- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Zabrak Disruptor Cannon
rows.desc:
Zabrak always command respect, especially with the aid of weapons that are even more damaging than already-outlawed standard disruptors.

- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber

rows.desc: It was a modified version of the DC-15A sniper rifle, dealing more damage, but containing less shots.
rows.role: very long range single shot; DPS 5.0

This weapon can overheat quickly when fully warmed up, resulting in a small battery explosion around the user.

rows.label: hold out blaster
rows.desc: Sometimes called a "sleeper," the hold out blaster is the preferred method of temporarily incapacitating an enemy.

rows.label: Bothan Needler
rows.desc:
For serious espionage, this is the weapon of choice. Simple ownership can get you arrested in some systems, or invited to dine with royalty, depending on what it helped you learn.

- Power Cell
- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

rows.label: Bothan Quick Draw

An unconscious opponent is a quiet opponent. This weapon is a Bothan favorite, designed to "create opportunities."

- Firing Chamber
- Trigger

These weapons are designed to incapacitate so death may be quick or lingered upon as desired. Droids are simply dispatched, as cruelty is best rationed among the living.

- Firing Chamber
- Beam Splitter

This unusual weapon was originally developed for use against veermok, a ferocious primate on Naboo that happens to be resistant to blaster fire. Much of the weapon's damage is electrical in nature, allowing it to bypass blaster resistance.
