It was a weapon that required skill and training, and was greatly enhanced when used in conjunction with the Force.

rows.label: Soul Saber
rows.desc: The Darksaber was a unique and ancient lightsaber, known for its distinctive black blade that projected a white glow along its edges. Created by the first Mandalorian Jedi, Tarre Vizsla, the Darksaber was revered as a symbol of leadership within Mandalorian culture. Unlike typical lightsabers, the Darksaber's blade was flat and curved like a traditional sword, and it produced a distinctive humming sound. The weapon's hilt was shorter than usual and featured a black, angular design. Over the centuries, the Darksaber was passed down through generations and became a sought-after artifact, symbolizing the rightful ruler of Mandalore.

rows.label: vibro-glaive
rows.desc: A variation of vibroweapon, the length providing the user a chance to keep out of reach of their opponent.
rows.role: melee, DPS 17.2; mostly cut; made of any Metallic; cuts armour

rows.label: vibro-axe
rows.desc: A variation of vibroweapon, the length providing the user a chance to keep out of reach of their opponent.
rows.role: melee, DPS 16.1; mostly cut; made of any Metallic; cuts armour

rows.label: persona monosword
rows.desc:
A crystal-metallic longsword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge. It cuts through even thick armor with ease, while its light weight and onboard persona permit extremely fast attacks.

This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.
rows.role: melee, DPS 16.0; mostly stab; cuts armour

rows.label: vibro-cleaver
rows.desc: A variation of vibroweapon with a large blade lending itself to slow but highly damaging attacks.
rows.role: melee, DPS 15.5; mostly cut; made of any Metallic; cuts armour

rows.label: Vibro Double-Blade
rows.desc: Ultrasonic vibrations make this double-bladed sword exceptionally deadly. A rare Echani cortosis weave protects it against lightsaber sparring damage, ensuring effectiveness even against Jedi and Sith. The double-bladed sword is capable of inflicting more damage - but is also less precise - than the single-bladed variant.

rows.label: Echani Double-Brand
rows.desc:
Echani Firedancers use the double bladed Ritual Brand in a dodging and slicing pattern so graceful it looks more like a dance than combat.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Sith War Sword
rows.desc:
Though most favor lightsabers, some Sith prefer the more visceral feel of metal cutting flesh. These blades are usually blended with cortosis to protect against lightsaber sparring damage.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Trandoshan Double-Blade
rows.desc: While most cultures abandoned the primitive sword in favor of vibroblades or other weapons, the Trandoshan sometimes use the weapon as a badge of honor. This variant is made of the rare ore Chalon, and is sharper and heavier than the typical blade. They are not suitable for weapon upgrades, however.

rows.label: Yusanis' Brand
rows.desc:
Yusanis was the most famous of Echani warriors, fighting against oppression and villainy until encountering Darth Revan. Discovering that Revan had killed an Echani senator, Yusanis attempted to tell authorities but fell to the powers of the Sith Lord despite his own impressive abilities and the cortosis weave inherent in all Echani vibroblades.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Imbued Blade
rows.desc: Force-imbued blades were solid metal blades that required no power source, and that glowed with the power of the Force coursing through them. This glow could manifest itself in multiple ways,
rows.role: melee, DPS 15.0; mostly force_saberslashsharp; made of any Metallic

rows.label: vibro-dagger
rows.desc: A variation of vibroweapon, small and light making it great for fast attacks.
rows.role: melee, DPS 14.9; mostly cut; made of any Metallic; cuts armour

rows.label: forsaken long blade
rows.desc: This Forsaken long sword takes little effort to lift and swing but can deal substantial damage.

rows.label: Scarlet Edge
rows.desc:
A legendary weapon of origin unknown.
The wielder of this mighty weapon feels compelled to wear a dark trenchcoat and answer questions with a grunt. Some may find this unsettling but none can deny its effectiveness in combat.
Unlocks a unique and deadly Special Skill animation.
rows.role: melee, DPS 14.0; mostly cut; cuts armour

rows.label: Curved Lightsaber
rows.desc: A curved lightsaber features a hilt with a curved design, offering unique handling and combat capabilities.

rows.label: Vibroglaive
rows.desc: Powered by ultrasonic generators, this polearm weapon is devastating in the hands of a skilled warrior. Vibroglaives are capable of rapid, thrusting attacks that leave enough space between wielder and foe to dodge any counterattack.

rows.label: Echani Vibroglaive
rows.desc:
Possessing a rare cortosis weave, this vibroglaive is one of the deadliest Echani weapons ever created.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell

rows.label: Krath War Lance
rows.desc:
Twisted by the dark side, the Krath favored weapons of fearsome appearance requiring brute strength to wield, and the blade of this weapon is certainly effective, if inelegant.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell

rows.label: forsaken bulk sword
rows.desc: A Forsaken equivalent of the gladius, common sidearms among Forsaken infantry. Terrible armor penetration, but easy to handle.

rows.label: warcasket plasma sword
rows.desc: A military modification of the Plasmasaw, adapted for use by warcaskets for anti-materiel purposes. The original intention for this bastard sword was for it to be able to extend like a whip while also having a simple straight form, however issues with containing the plasma shelved the idea. Instead, the links are used to change the length of the sword as well as allow easier replacement of damaged sections.

rows.label: forsaken battle axe
rows.desc: The traditional Forsaken battle axe deals a lot of damage on impact, at the cost of unwealdy shape and weight.

rows.label: Tehk'la Blade
rows.desc: This weapon is favored by the Nagai, a species of slender humanoids who appear more dead than alive. Known for their honor and combat skill, the Nagai use these serrated weapons to cripple their opponents.

rows.label: monosword
rows.desc: A crystal-metallic longsword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge. It cuts through even thick armor with ease, and its light weight permits fast attacks.
rows.role: melee, DPS 12.1; mostly stab; cuts armour

rows.label: warcasket broadsword
rows.desc: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.

rows.label: Lightsaber(Shoto)
rows.desc: A shoto lightsaber, also known as a short lightsaber, is a smaller variant of the traditional lightsaber. Its compact size offers agility and versatility in combat.

rows.label: laser sword
rows.desc: An ultratech device consisting of a handle and an extendable laser blade. A weapon of gentlemen.
rows.role: melee, DPS 11.7; mostly cut; cuts armour

rows.label: Prototype Vibroblade
rows.desc:
This is a very adaptable model of vibroblade, made for the user on a budget that will be purchasing upgrades as resources or finances become available.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Vibroblade
rows.desc: Small size makes this a good off-hand weapon. Echani vibroblades use a cortosis weave to prevent lightsaber sparring damage, allowing traditional swordplay to continue in the time of Jedi and Sith.

rows.label: Echani Vibroblade
rows.desc:
These blades are typically used in the off hand. In addition to a cortosis weave that deflects lightsaber sparring damage, some Echani vibroblades are supercooled to keep them in alignment, giving them an icy sting.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Krath Blood Blade
rows.desc:
Twisted by the dark side, this Krath weapon is as deadly as a modern vibroblade. It was meant for assassination, and a cortosis weave that prevents lightsaber sparring damage ensured that even Jedi must respect it.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Sanasiki's Blade
rows.desc:
Sanasiki used this weapon to kill Nelinik, a Zabrak who assassinated the Echani High Protector with battle droids. Cortosis protects the blade against lightsaber sparring damage while energy cells disrupt droid opponents.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Mission's Vibroblade
rows.desc:
Working with few resources, Mission Vao turned this basic vibroblade into an exceptional weapon almost as adaptable as she is.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: persona plasmasword
rows.desc:
A metal-cored sword with a cutting edge. Plasma is wrapped around the core, held in place by an energy field. Targets are both sliced by the metal core, as well as burned or ignited by the plasma sheath.

This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

rows.label: tuk'ata tail spike
rows.desc: The poisonous tail spike of a Tuk'ata. Good enough to fend off most living enemies.

rows.label: warcasket combat knife
rows.desc: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.

rows.label: precision scalpel
rows.desc: An ultra-sharp surgical instrument crafted from the finest steel alloys. The carefully balanced blade maintains its edge through repeated sterilization and use, while the ergonomic handle ensures precise control during delicate medical procedures. Standard equipment in advanced medical facilities.
rows.role: melee, DPS 10.4; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: Darksaber
rows.desc: The Darksaber was a unique and ancient lightsaber, known for its distinctive black blade that projected a white glow along its edges. Created by the first Mandalorian Jedi, Tarre Vizsla, the Darksaber was revered as a symbol of leadership within Mandalorian culture. Unlike typical lightsabers, the Darksaber's blade was flat and curved like a traditional sword, and it produced a distinctive humming sound. The weapon's hilt was shorter than usual and featured a black, angular design. Over the centuries, the Darksaber was passed down through generations and became a sought-after artifact, symbolizing the rightful ruler of Mandalore.

rows.label: Lightsaber
rows.desc: The lightsaber, also referred to as a laser sword by those who were unfamiliar with it, was a weapon usually used by the Jedi, Sith, and other Force-sensitives. Lightsabers consisted of a plasma blade, powered by a kyber crystal, that was emitted from a usually metal hilt and could be shut off at will. It was a weapon that required skill and training, and was greatly enhanced when used in conjunction with the Force.

rows.label: scarodon fang dagger
rows.desc: A dagger forged from the fang of a Scarodon, bound to a Megabone handle. Lethal in close combat and favored by skilled tribal hunters.

rows.label: forsaken spear
rows.desc: A Forsaken spear. Deals great damage, but can be difficult to handle.

rows.label: pyrinth blade
rows.desc: A thin shard of pyrinth held into a metal hilt. The crystalline nature of the ore makes the sword sharper than any metal, and light to swing. The ore's properties also allow the blade to burn and sear flesh.

rows.label: Gaffi stick
rows.desc: The gaderffii, or gaffi stick, is the traditional melee weapon of the sandpeople. It was a pole weapon with a spike or blade on one end and some kind of bludgeoning instrument on the other.
rows.role: melee, DPS 10.0; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody/Stony

rows.label: rapier
rows.desc: An elegant blade designed for duels, equally capable of quick stabs and devastating slashes. Its light weight and robust handguard let the wielder manouver around, making them harder to hit.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.9; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: rending claws
rows.desc: Mutated claws used by the Infested to tear through steel, flesh and bone. Once removed from the Infested, they may be repurposed.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.6; mostly cut; made of any Metallic

rows.label: Vibrosword
rows.desc: Ultrasonic generators power this Echani-developed weapon design. A rare cortosis weave that protects against sparring damage ensures that traditional swordplay will endure in the time of lightsabers.

rows.label: Bacca's Ceremonial Blade
rows.desc:
The great Bacca was hunting the Shadowlands ages ago when an alien ship crashed through the forest. He saw that first contact as a warning of the destruction outsiders could bring. Made from the debris, this sword is a reminder for his people that trust must be given cautiously, and only to those who have earned it.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Baragwin Assault Blade
rows.desc:
This advanced vibrosword is a miracle of miniaturization technology. Not only does it deliver increased functionality over a normal vibrosword, it also has capacitors which discharge upon contact with a target. Extra space within the blade can be utilized by a variety of common upgrade modules.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Echani Foil
rows.desc:
These swords were crafted to honor Raskta Fenni, the best Echani duelist of her time. Many were sold, but imperfections in the difficult lightsaber-deflecting cortosis weave caused few to survive.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Exchange Poison Blade
rows.desc: Forged by the Exchange for the exclusive use of their agents, this deadly assassin's blade contains a cannister that emits small doses of poison with each successful hit on an opponent.

rows.label: Krath Dire Sword
rows.desc:
This was a weapon of distinction in the time of the Krath. Protected against lightsaber sparring damage, Sith would grant these cortosis-laced blades to only the most loyal underlings.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: Sith Tremor Sword
rows.desc:
Traced to the Bladeborn, a Sith offshoot dedicated to sword mastery, these cortosis-laced weapons were given to "masterblades" who survived no less than ten lightsaber-wielding warriors in combat.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell
- Grip

rows.label: giant sword
rows.desc: A very large sword with grip for one-handed use. It is far too unwieldly for normal person to use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.4; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: Sword of Surtr
rows.desc:
An enormous one-handed sword with a blade wreathed in the barely-contained power of the sun. The sword burns, cuts, and melts through anything unfortunate enough to meet it's edge.

The sword is so large and heavy that even giants often struggle to wield it.

rows.label: Persona Sword of Surtr
rows.desc:
An enormous one-handed sword with a blade wreathed in the barely-contained power of the sun. The sword burns, cuts, and melts through anything unfortunate enough to meet it's edge.

The sword is so large and heavy that even giants often struggle to wield it.

rows.label: ceremonial blade
rows.desc: A traditional serrated ceremonial sword, wielded by the most skilled and powerful of the Keshig families. It is difficult to use by inexperienced users due to it's size and unusual shape, but it can cause painful lacerations and wounds.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.3; mostly dv_lacerate; made of any Metallic

rows.label: crystal mantis scythe
rows.desc: A chitinous weapon made from the claws of a giant mantis. It excells at stunning and slicing open enemies.

rows.label: serrated scimitar
rows.desc: A common one-handed blade of Keshig design. Banned on many worlds due to it's serrated edge, it is swift to swing and deals some truly terrible cuts and lacerations.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.0; mostly dv_lacerate; made of any Metallic

rows.label: Skarstind
rows.desc: This enormous axe brings the chill of Niflheim itself. Which is a fancy way of saying that the cryogenic properties of the edge is devastatingly dangerous.

rows.label: Broadsaber
rows.desc:
The broadsaber was a type of specialized lightsaber model. Due to specialized focusing lenses and emitters, the broadsaber's hilt made a blade that was broader and flatter than a standard lightsaber's cylindrical blade, and as such, gave it a profile that was closer to that of a traditional metal sword. The broadsaber provided a larger overall surface for the blade, while losing the advantages of an omnidirectional cutting edge.

Because of this, broadsabers were not popular among the members of the Jedi Order, with many Jedi Masters believing that it was less elegant than standard lightsabers. Despite this, broadsabers were well suited for Form I techniques, so the form had some masters with the broadsaber.

rows.label: Crossguard Lightsaber
rows.desc: A crossguard lightsaber is a unique variant of the traditional lightsaber, featuring a blade with two smaller perpendicular blades at the hilt. This design provides additional defensive capabilities and a distinctive appearance. It is often wielded by those who value both form and function in combat.

rows.label: longsword
rows.desc: The ancient weapon of kings, the longsword can be used for slashing or stabbing.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.6; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: Persona Skarstind
rows.desc: This enormus axe brings the chill of Niflheim itself. Which is a fancy way of saying that the edge is incredibly cold.

rows.label: giant scythe
rows.desc: An enormus scythe for harvesting very large crops (or smaller creatures). Aside of double as a mean-looking pick it can also be effectively used to trip or sweep the legs of/off other giants.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.4; mostly cut; made of any Metallic

rows.label: Vae Suis
rows.desc: This enormous spear said to bring disaster. It cuts not with a sharp edge but rather an unbelievable heat that simply vaporizes most that it touches.

rows.label: Persona Vae Suis
rows.desc: This enormous spear said to bring disaster. It cuts not with a sharp edge but rather an unbelievable heat that simply vaporizes most that it touches.

rows.label: combat knife
rows.desc: OA refined and deadly tool, the military combat knife has taken many forms, but the concept has always remained the same: A handle for a sure grip and a sharp edge for cutting and thrusting, optimized for battlefield use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.2; mostly stab; made of any Metallic

rows.label: shovel
rows.desc: One of the most versatile tools for a soldier, the entrenching tool is a simple but effective weapon. With a sturdy handle and a sharpened, heavy blade, it serves equally well for digging a trench or bludgeoning an enemy.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.1; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: steel knife
rows.desc: A precision-forged steel knife with superior edge retention and durability. The high-carbon steel blade maintains its sharpness through extensive use, making it ideal for demanding butchery and medical work. The ergonomic handle provides excellent control for delicate operations.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.1; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: stake
rows.desc: A sharpened wooden log. Can deal substantial damage, but is prone to breaking and deteriorates fast. Good at killing sanguophages.

rows.label: spear
rows.desc: A polearm tipped with a sharp point for stabbing opponents.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.9; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: gnaut horn mace
rows.desc: A reinforced mace forged from the horns of the mighty Gnaut, fused into a Megabone core. It strikes with crushing force and serrated edges.

rows.label: claw saber
rows.desc: A savage blade crafted from the claws of a colossal beast. It is light and fast, allowing swift slashes and precise stabs.

rows.label: plasmasword
rows.desc: A metal-cored sword with a cutting edge. Plasma is wrapped around the core, held in place by an energy field. Targets are both sliced by the metal core, as well as burned or ignited by the plasma sheath.

rows.label: cryptoaxe
rows.desc: A heavy, high-tech axe with a cryogenic-coated edge that delivers crushing strikes. On impact, it inflicts deep frostburns, flash-freezing flesh and lacing wounds with cryptofreeze, slowing movement and dealing substantial hypothermic damage over time.

rows.label: gladius
rows.desc: A short sword of ancient design. Good for stabbing or slashing. It's light and nimble, which sometimes lets it beat bigger, heavier weapons.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.5; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: dusk spear
rows.desc: A ceremonial spear forged from the sharpened horn of the Duskhorn. Revered among twilight tribes for its elegance and lethality.

rows.label: power drill
rows.desc: A mechanized drilling tool powered by an internal motor, capable of boring through tough materials with precision and speed. The variable-speed motor and interchangeable bits make it invaluable for construction and mechanical work. Requires periodic maintenance to keep the motor running smoothly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.4; mostly stab; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: hatchet
rows.desc: A small, single-handed axe designed for quick, repeated strikes. Its light weight and short handle allow for fast swinging speed. Using a hatchet increases the plant harvest yield slightly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.3; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: fungal mantis scythe
rows.desc: A chitinous weapon made from the claws of a giant mantis. It excells at slashing at enemies while injecting two types of fungal spores into enemies.

rows.label: ikwa
rows.desc: A short spearhandle attached to a long bladed point, designed to be driven into vital organs with a quick thrust.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.0; mostly stab; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: giant shard knife
rows.desc: A large sharp piece of salvage with a handle tied around it to avoid injuring the wilder. The handle makes it a bit too awkward for a regular-sized person to wield.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.8; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody/Stony

rows.label: axe
rows.desc: An advanced form of one of mankind's oldest weapons, the war axe is a short blade attached to a shaft. The simple, ancient design concentrates cutting power generated from strong overhand swings.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.7; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: Vibroaxe
rows.desc: These ultrasonic-powered axes are weighted to deliver strong blows while keeping an opponent at bay. The added vibrations help the blade cleave through armor when a strike lands, and the heavy counterbalance on the opposite end easily knocks the target off balance.

rows.label: Kajidic Soldier's Axe
rows.desc:
The underlings of the Hutt clans have wielded these weapons for many millenia, though as the military involvement of the Hutts has decreased since the Xim wars, these are mostly just used to indimidate outlanders who do business with the Kajidics.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell

rows.label: Sith Executioner Axe
rows.desc:
Unlike most vibroweapons developed by the Sith, these axes were mostly ceremonial in nature. The Sith under Darth Malak reveled in the messy, public executions of political dissidents, and many Republic officers met their fate under these energy-tipped axes.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Blade Edge
- Energy Cell

rows.label: battle axe
rows.desc: A hefty, two-handed axe designed for cleaving through foes. Its wide, sharp blade delivers devastating cutting damage, while its mass allows for powerful but slow strikes.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.5; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: knife
rows.desc: A versatile cutting implement with a sharp blade essential for precise work. Perfect for butchery operations, medical procedures, and general cutting tasks. The balanced design allows for controlled, accurate cuts while the keen edge ensures clean work. An indispensable tool for any serious colonist.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.5; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: knife
rows.desc: One of mankind's oldest manufactured objects. The knife has taken many forms, but the concept has always remained the same: A handle for holding and a sharp edge for cutting.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.5; mostly stab; made of any Metallic

rows.label: glitterworld multitool
rows.desc: A high-tech universal tool commonly used by domestic mechanoids in glitterworld societies. This advanced device can seamlessly adapt to any task - construction, mining, forestry, maintenance, and deconstruction - making it the ultimate all-in-one survival tool. Though designed for mechanoids, it's perfectly usable by humanoids due to physiological similarities.

rows.label: carbide pickaxe
rows.desc: An advanced mining implement featuring carbide-tipped edges that maintain their sharpness through the most demanding excavation work. The precision-engineered head cuts through rock more efficiently than standard tools, while the reinforced construction ensures exceptional durability in harsh mining conditions.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.0; mostly stab; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: axe
rows.desc: A fundamental forestry tool designed for efficient tree felling. Its weighted head delivers powerful cutting strikes, making it indispensable for colonists working with wood. The balance and leverage make it far superior to improvised cutting methods. Also serves as a reliable melee weapon when survival demands it.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.5; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: pickaxe
rows.desc: An essential mining implement featuring a heavy, pointed head mounted on a sturdy handle. Specifically engineered to break through solid rock and extract valuable materials efficiently. The concentrated force and leverage it provides are crucial for productive mining operations. Can double as an improvised weapon when circumstances require it.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.5; mostly stab; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: primitive axe
rows.desc: Effective at chopping down trees thanks to the head that's attached to its handle. This can also be used as a melee weapon in a pinch.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.5; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: crystal
rows.desc: Blue crystal mined from crystal caves.

rows.label: poleaxe
rows.desc: A versatile polearm featuring a sharp axe head and a back spike, designed for rapid, decisive blows against armored foes. The reach of the poleaxe allows to strike enemies much further away.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.4; mostly cut; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: primitive sickle
rows.desc: A curved blade that's attached to a small handle which is typically used to cut plants. This can also be used as a melee weapon in a pinch.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: sickle
rows.desc: A specialized agricultural tool featuring a curved cutting blade perfectly designed for harvesting crops and cutting plant matter. The ergonomic design allows for efficient, repetitive cutting motions while reducing strain on the user. Essential for productive farming operations and plant maintenance tasks.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: crosscut saw
rows.desc: A precision industrial saw designed for efficient lumber processing and construction work. The specially designed teeth and reinforced steel construction allow for clean, accurate cuts through various materials. Essential for large-scale construction projects and advanced woodworking operations.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.4; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: hoe
rows.desc: A fundamental agricultural implement engineered for soil preparation and seed planting. The pointed design efficiently breaks through earth and creates optimal planting conditions. Indispensable for establishing productive farming operations and maintaining crop yields. Its sturdy construction ensures reliable performance season after season.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.1; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: pry bar
rows.desc: A primitive but effective leverage tool crafted from durable materials. Essential for dismantling structures, prying apart materials, and performing basic mechanical operations. Represents the ingenuity of early civilizations in developing practical solutions for construction and deconstruction tasks without advanced technology.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.1; mostly stab; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: hand saw
rows.desc: A traditional woodworking tool featuring a metal blade with precisely cut teeth designed for manual lumber processing. Essential for construction projects requiring custom-cut timber and detailed woodwork. The steady rhythm of hand-sawing may take longer than power tools, but provides excellent control and precision.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.0; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: bone sickle
rows.desc: A primitive harvesting tool crafted from carved bone with a sharpened edge. While not as durable as metal variants, this traditional implement serves admirably for crop harvesting and plant cutting. The curved design follows ancient patterns proven effective across countless generations of agricultural work.
rows.role: melee, DPS 3.3; mostly cut; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: stone flake
rows.desc: A sharp flake of hard stone, knapped naturally from a larger rock. Crude but just barely functional as a cutting or digging implement. It won't last long - but it might get you through the first few days until you can craft something better.

rows.label: scalpel
rows.desc: A precision-crafted cutting tool designed for delicate work. Despite its size, the scalpel’s razor‑thin blade allows for incisions far more precise than any knife. The damage it can deal with each stab reflects the medical skill of the user.
rows.role: melee, DPS 0.6; mostly vqea_scalpel; made of any Metallic

rows.label: persona grav hammer
rows.desc:
A warhammer with a Gravcore. Upon impact, it blasts the target with a gravity blast in addition to the physical damage.
Сauses huge damage to buildings.(>1000)


This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.
rows.role: melee, DPS 18.0; mostly blunt; cuts armour

rows.label: Electrostaff
rows.desc: An electrostaff was a staff-like melee weapon manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Holowan Mechanicals. They were used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems' IG-100 MagnaGuard.

rows.label: persona zeushammer
rows.desc:
A warhammer with an embedded EMP capacitor. Upon impact, it blasts the target with an EMP burst in addition to the physical damage.

This weapon has an onboard persona that can bond to only a single person. The wielder and intelligent weapon can synchronize their reflexes and attack with frightening speed, accuracy, and creativity. Once bonded to a wielder, the weapon's persona will refuse to be wielded by anyone else.

rows.label: grav hammer

A warhammer with a Gravcore. Upon impact, it blasts the target with a gravity blast in addition to the physical damage.
Сauses huge damage to buildings.(>1000)
rows.role: melee, DPS 13.3; mostly blunt; cuts armour

rows.label: electrostaff
rows.desc: Similar to the common Stun Baton, Electrostaffs discharge a high amount of energy into an opponent. Unlike their smaller relatives however, Electrostaffs are designed to injure and kill through blunt force and electrocution, and are a difficult weapon to wield effectively.

rows.label: Gand Shockstaff
rows.desc:
The pinnacle of Gand technology, the discharger can both paralyze and slay opponents with ease. These potent items are extremely rare as they are highly coveted by the few Gand who have earned them.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Geonosian Electrostaff
rows.desc:
Geonosians are winged bipeds covered with protective bony plates. They are highly competitive and generally look down upon other species. Their electro-staves therefore only rarely find their way off of their homeworld of Geonosis.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Jedi Hunter Electrostaff
rows.desc:
During their wars against the Republic, the Mandalorians found Electrostaves were the most efficient melee weapon for dealing with Jedi. Elite squadrons of "Jedi hunters" trained extensively with these weapons and were sent to kill high-profile Jedi during the Mandalorian Wars.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Vulkar Shock Stick
rows.desc:
A favorite weapon of the Vulkars, this modified electrostaff is designed more for the purpose of inflicting pain than actually incapacitating an opponent.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Core Alloy

rows.label: gaderffii stick
rows.desc: A gaderffii stick, also known simply as a gaderffii or gaffi stick, was a bladed club used by the Tusken Raiders. They were used to jab and pummel their victims. Though a primitive weapon, it was nevertheless extremely deadly in the right hands.
rows.role: melee, DPS 12.7; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic

rows.label: Thorhammer
rows.desc: A warhammer with an embedded ultratech device that summons lightning strikes on impact. The warhammer shields the user from some of the impact of the flames.
rows.role: melee, DPS 12.3; mostly thorhammerblunt; cuts armour

rows.label: Skrýmir's Mallet
rows.desc:
An absurdly large and heavy hammer of unknown origin. It is claimed to be imbued with the power of a winter storm.

The few things the thunderous blows of the hammer does not outright pulverize by force alone are turned brittle by frost and stunned by the thunderous impact.

rows.label: Persona Skrýmir's Mallet
rows.desc:
An absurdly large and heavy hammer of unknown origin. It is claimed to be imbued with the power of a winter storm.

The few things the thunderous blows of the hammer does not outright pulverize by force alone are turned brittle by frost and stunned by the thunderous impact.

rows.label: zeushammer
rows.desc: A warhammer with an embedded EMP capacitor. Upon impact, it blasts the target with an EMP burst in addition to the physical damage.

rows.label: warcasket gravity hammer
rows.desc: A monumental piece of anti-personnel technology that can only be properly utilized by the oversized warcaskets. Practically an engine block fitted to the end of a mech’s limb actuator, equipped with multiple pneumatic plates covering miniature repulsor generators designed for riot control. In layman’s terms, a strike from the head will launch the target backwards by several meters.

rows.label: rhinhammer
rows.desc: A colossal warhammer crafted from the fossilized horn of the Worhin. Its overwhelming weight can crush armor and stone alike, though it is unwieldy and slow to swing.

rows.label: giant warhammer
rows.desc: A massive warhammer far too unwieldly for normal person to use. Also amazingly good at demolishing buildings.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.1; mostly demolish; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: giant hammer
rows.desc: A huge one-handed hammer which is too unwieldly for normal person to use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.7; mostly blunt; made of any Stony/Metallic

rows.label: giant salvage club
rows.desc: A giant club with a bunch of sharp metal pieces stuck in it.

rows.label: stun baton
rows.desc: Stun batons are commonly employed by police forces who prefer to incapacitate instead of kill their targets.

rows.label: Bothan Chuka
rows.desc:
A very effective device used by Bothan elite. Some systems consider simple possession of one as grounds for execution as a spy.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Gand Silencer
rows.desc:
It's unclear whether this weapon was designed by the Gand or to silence them.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Rakatan Battle Wand
rows.desc:
Weighted to fit a Rakatan grip, this item is most like a stun baton. The energy field surrounding the shaft functions similar to a bolt from a disruptor weapon, reducing solid matter to its constituent molecules.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: Exchange Negotiator
rows.desc:
A useful tool for espionage, this weapon is more effective than the standard stun baton, but is still available on most worlds.

UPGRADE SLOTS:
- Energy Cell
- Grip
- Core Alloy

rows.label: baton
rows.desc: A sturdy, weighted club used for incapacitation and crowd control. Its dense construction delivers powerful blunt force trauma, favored by police and security forces for non-lethal (and sometimes lethal) engagements.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.3; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: giant club
rows.desc: A huge heavy club which is too unwieldly for normal person to use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.2; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody/Stony

rows.label: giant primitive hammer
rows.desc: A huge primitive one-handed stone hammer which is too unwieldly for normal person to use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.2; mostly blunt; made of any Stony

rows.label: huge kanabō
rows.desc: A giant spiked club that is far too unwieldly for normal person to use.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.2; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Stony/Woody

rows.label: aminox warmaul
rows.desc: A brutal war maul built from twin Aminox horns and bound to a Megabone core. Unlike the fossil thunder of greater relic hammers, this weapon kills through sheer density and crushing weight. Each swing lands like a cold, heavy ram, splintering bone, denting armor, and staggering anything too slow to avoid it.

rows.label: mace
rows.desc: A refined club, engineered for efficient swinging and deadly impacts.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.0; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: warhammer
rows.desc: A long polearm topped with a brutal hammer. The powerful blunt impacts can pulverize an enemy's insides, even through armor.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.9; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: hammer
rows.desc: A simple, single-handed weapon with a heavy head, designed to deliver powerful blunt force to crush enemies. Using a hammer increases the construction speed slightly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.8; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody

rows.label: brontorhin
rows.desc: The fossilized horn of the Worhin, metallic and thunderous, resonating with the power of ancient titans. Tribes revere it as a sacred relic, capable of channeling the fury of storms and shattering stone.

rows.label: club
rows.desc: A shaped stick, heavy at one end, for bashing enemies to death. This weapon is so old it's part of human biology. Evolutionary biologists say that a major reason humans can tilt our wrists side-to-side (instead of just forward-and-back like other primates) is to be able to better swing a club.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.3; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic/Woody/Stony

rows.label: megabone club
rows.desc: A primitive yet powerful club carved from a single block of Megabone. Heavy, crude, but devastating in skilled hands.

rows.label: red wood
rows.desc: This red tinged wood is oddly strong, and a sweet scent emanates from it. Less flammable than terrestrial wood, but quite ugly.

rows.label: hammer
rows.desc: The cornerstone tool of any construction project. This versatile hammer provides the precision and force needed for driving fasteners, shaping materials, and assembling structures. Essential for colonists engaged in building and maintenance work. Its balanced design ensures effective strikes while minimizing fatigue during extended construction tasks.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly blunt; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: primitive hammer
rows.desc: A simple hammer that's a vital part of any constructor's arsenal of tools. This can also be used as a melee weapon in a pinch.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly blunt; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: breach axe
rows.desc: A combined blade and tool-head attached to a sturdy haft. While slightly less effective than other weapons against human enemies, it excels at tearing down walls, doors, and other structures thanks to its integrated tool-head.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly blunt; made of any Metallic

rows.label: chunk
rows.desc: A chunk of rock, carefully picked to have the highest smashing potential.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.3; mostly blunt; made of any VFET_StoneChunks

rows.label: wrench
rows.desc: A precision mechanical tool engineered for gripping, turning, and manipulating fasteners and mechanical components. Critical for maintenance operations, machinery repair, and construction projects requiring exact adjustments. The adjustable jaw design accommodates various sizes while providing optimal leverage and control.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.1; mostly blunt; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: mushroom log
rows.desc:
Material from large fibrous fungi. Useful for building structures and weapons. Good animal feed, but largely inedible for humans. 

Does not burn easily and cannot be used as fuel for normal burning but can be used for darklight sources.

rows.label: tox wood
rows.desc: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants that live in polluted areas. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg. Due to its poor quality, anything made from it will be of lesser quality.

rows.label: wood
rows.desc: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants. Useful for building structures and weapons. It is a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel. In a pinch, a piece of wood can be used as a weapon or a leg.

rows.label: torch
rows.desc: Wood from trees or other fibrous plants, wrapped in cloth and soaked in a flammable substance. Can be used as a weapon in a pinch.

rows.label: eltex staff
rows.desc: An ultratech staff threaded with psychic focusing materials. While it is a solid melee weapon, its main purpose is to enhance the wielder's psychic sensitivity and neural heat dissipation, allowing more use of psychic powers.

rows.label: mushroom wine
rows.desc: Fungi fermented into an alcoholic beverage not entirely unlike wine. It's an acquired taste, tangy with a hint of agar.

rows.label: beer
rows.desc: The first beverage besides water ever consumed by mankind. Beer can taste good, but its main effect is intoxication. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.

rows.label: gorewine
rows.desc: An odd drink brewed originally by keshig warriors. Characteristically sweet with hints of iron, gorewine is unmistakeably alcoholic, even just a whiff can make most drowsy. Brewed by fermenting animal blood with berry juices, the beverage is a staple of keshig culture, and is often brought along on their warships for celebratory feasts. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.

rows.label: fungus beer
rows.desc: The first thing you need to get your day in the mountains startet. Fungus beer can taste good, but its main effect is intoxication. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.

rows.label: tarisian ale
rows.desc: Tarisian ale is an extremely strong alcoholic beverage brewed on the planet Taris. It was one of the planet's main exports and commanded a high price. The ale was made from the glands of a tach, and because of the need for this ingredient there were substantial imports of tach glands from Kashyyyk. Consuming just one was enough to intoxicate, or even incapacitate, inexperienced drinkers or even experienced drinkers who were having their first Tarisian ale.

rows.label: double-aged whiskey
rows.desc: The result of whiskey being aged once more in an unused or lightly used secondary barrel. Flavor profiles are stronger and the afterburn in one's throat notably reduced. The increased aging time for fine whiskey generally portrays a sense of mercantilism and class among its consumers.

rows.label: gin
rows.desc: A particularly mild and colorless spirit, aromatically speaking this bottle has a pine-tree like scent as well as subtle fruity notes. This liquor has a reputation for being light-hearted and fun to drink and for causing what is known as  “gin drunkenness”, during which one feels increased empathy and understanding.

rows.label: soda
rows.desc: A very sweet and semi-citrusy beverage best enjoyed chilled. Whilst not exactly nutritious the sugar rush is welcomed and the effervescence is quite refreshing.

rows.label: tequila
rows.desc: A fermented liquor made from agave sap, a favorite of wild, rowdy banditos and muffalo wranglers alike. Includes a high-protein snack at the bottom of the bottle believed to bring good luck. Imbibers are known to excel at extended combat.

rows.label: vodka
rows.desc: A clear and mostly flavorless alcohol made from fermented potatoes. While vodka is drinkable alone it is mostly known for being a perfect mixing agent and for causing foolishly high levels of boldness in those who choose to drink it.

rows.label: whiskey
rows.desc: A potent liquor distilled from fermented grain. The flavors of the aging barrel tend to permeate this spirit more than others. A woody, almost smokey flavor is pronounced throughout. Simple whiskeys are stereotypically associated with rough manual laborers and hard workers, a common sight in steamworlds across the galaxy.

rows.label: rum
rows.desc:
A highly alcoholic beverage made from the recycled bodily fluids of those wearing rumsuits.

An ingenious way of not only improving morale but also allowing crew to operate longer without needing to resupply for food or dispose of human waste. Rum is very thick to drink - much like a protein shake - and the alcohol helps mask the otherwise unpleasant taste from repurposed nutrient paste dispenser technology.

rows.label: crystalline wood
rows.desc: These brittle crystalline strands can be extracted from crystal flowers. Not flammable, but not strong at all. Internally, the are formed by a fine lattice of exotic crystals, creating a structure that is incredibly good at maintaining a constant temperature.

rows.label: mushroom stalks
rows.desc: These mushroom stalks have been hardened by age until they are almost as firm as a low quality wood. Very flammable, and not very resistant.

rows.label: microscope
rows.desc: A precision optical instrument that magnifies small objects and specimens for detailed examination. Essential for advanced research, biological studies, and scientific analysis.
rows.role: melee, DPS 2.5; mostly blunt; made of any Woody/Stony/Metallic

rows.label: abacus
rows.desc: An ancient calculating instrument featuring movable beads arranged on rods for performing arithmetic operations. Essential for organizing research data, managing complex calculations, and maintaining accurate records in societies without advanced computational devices. Represents the foundation of mathematical thinking and data organization.
rows.role: melee, DPS 2.4; mostly blunt; made of any Woody/Stony

rows.label: bone
rows.desc: Bones from a once living thing. Useful for building structures or weapons. A bone can be used as a weapon in a pinch.
rows.mod: Rim of Madness - Bones Unofficial Fix

rows.label: alpha thrumbo horn
rows.desc:
An alpha thrumbo's horn. It's razor-sharp and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy, as well as a deadly melee weapon.

The alpha horn is much lighter than a normal thrumbo horn, making it much faster to wield.
rows.role: melee, DPS 19.1; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: krayt dragon horn
rows.desc: A krayt dragon's horn. Good enough to fend off some enemies. A valuable and potentially useful weapon if needed.
rows.role: melee, DPS 14.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: rancor tooth
rows.desc: A rancors tooth. Good enough to fend off some enemies.  A valuable and potentially useful weapon if needed.
rows.role: melee, DPS 14.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: plastemmoth tusk
rows.desc: The crystalline tusk of a plastemmoth. It radiates a faint mineral shimmer and is valued both as a trophy and as a formidable weapon when wielded.
rows.role: melee, DPS 12.1; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: gallatross horn
rows.desc: A Gallatross' horn. This rock-hard horn is very valuable, and given the dangers inherent in hunting a Gallatross, a scarce commodity.
rows.role: melee, DPS 11.7; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: bloodletter blade
rows.desc:
A sinister blade forged to spill blood - and keep it flowing. With each jagged slash it inflicts, it leaves behind micro-shards of toxic metal within its target's body. These fragments have a hemorrhagic effect, preventing coagulation and swiftly transforming a trickle of red into a stream of crimson if left untreated.

The original blades are said to have been forged by the Beliar out of pilfered cult relics, and used to slaughter their former owners and their psychic abominations. With enough esoteric knowledge and access to exotic materials, one could perhaps make them again.
rows.role: melee, DPS 11.1; mostly gs_bleeddamage; cuts armour

rows.label: cave spider head
rows.desc: The head of a giant cave spider. It's priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy and needed for special items. It can also be used as a weird weapon.

rows.label: bunker bug claw
rows.desc: A bunker bug claw. It's razor-sharp, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy, as well as a deadly melee weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 10.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: thrumbo horn
rows.desc: A thrumbo's horn. It's razor-sharp, rock-hard, and priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy, as well as a deadly melee weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 10.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: platybelodon tusk
rows.desc: A platybelodon's tusk. Somewhat small, compared to those of other proboscidea. Could be used as a stabbing weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.8; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: drog tusk
rows.desc: The tusk of a northern drog. A valuable and durable trophy which can be wielded as a deadly weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.4; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: goldilox horn
rows.desc: The twisted horn of a goldilox. A valuable and durable trophy which can be wielded as a deadly weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.4; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: deermoss horn
rows.desc: Even outside the animal's body, the antler seems to pulse with the vascularized energy of living staghorn moss. Its dense, incredibly heavy core delivers unexpected concussive force, often stunning those struck.
rows.role: melee, DPS 9.0; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: duskhorn horn
rows.desc: A massive, spiraled horn harvested from a mature duskhorn bull. Its dense and curved structure makes it ideal for use as a piercing weapon or ceremonial relic.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.6; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: deinotherium tusk
rows.desc: A deinotherium's tusk. Very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy, it could be used for stabbing.
rows.role: melee, DPS 8.0; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: elasmotherium horn
rows.desc: An elasmotherium's horn. Not nearly as deadly in human hands, but can still prove to be a relatively decent weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.5; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: mastmot tusk
rows.desc: An mastmot tusk. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.5; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: crystal mimic mantis claw
rows.desc: A claw from a crystal mimic mantis. It's priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy and needed for special weapons.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: royal rhino beetle horn
rows.desc: A royal rhino beetle's horn. It's priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy and needed for special items.
rows.role: melee, DPS 7.3; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: mastodon tusk
rows.desc: A mastodon's tusk. Traders pay handsomely for samples like this. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it still hits quite hard.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.9; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: gnaut horn
rows.desc: A dense and resilient horn harvested from a mature male gnaut. Though smaller and less imposing than a duskhorn horn, its sturdy curved shape makes it well suited for use as a crude piercing weapon, ritual object, or valuable tribal trophy.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.8; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: elephant tusk
rows.desc: An elephant's tusk. It is very durable and valuable. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.8; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: aminox horn
rows.desc: A colossal horn harvested from an adult Aminox. Thick, heavy, and ridged by years of battering ice, stone, and rival beasts, it is less suited for elegant piercing than smaller horns, but prized for its sheer mass and use in legendary blunt weapons, ritual trophies, and frontier craftsmanship.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.1; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: manka tooth
rows.desc: A manka cats tooth. While not ideal as a melee weapon, it's true value comes in the strange curative properties experienced when held.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.0; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: mammoth tusk
rows.desc: A mammoth's tusk. Very durable and valuable. Deadly but somewhat unwieldy as a weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 6.0; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: fungal mimic mantis claw
rows.desc: A claw from a fungal mimic mantis. It's priceless in most markets. This is a true trophy and needed for special weapons.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.9; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: smilodon fangs
rows.desc: A dead smilodon's pair of canines. Although a fantastic trophy, they aren't as good of a weapon when used by humans.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.9; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: Capryak horn
rows.desc: A long, angled horn harvested from a mature Capryak. Dense, resilient, and naturally sharpened by years of impact against stone, ice, and rival beasts, its structure makes it well suited for use as a crude piercing weapon, ritual object, or prized frontier trophy.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.7; mostly stab; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: nerf horn
rows.desc: A horn from a Nerf, can be used as a weapon or sold for profit.
rows.role: melee, DPS 5.2; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: sivatherium horn
rows.desc:
A dense, horn harvested from the colossal Sivatherium. Centuries of exposure to RimWorld’s reactive soils and dormant technogenic residues have fused bone and mineral into a single bioactive structure.

When ground and refined, it releases microscopic compounds that interact with organic tissue, forming the base for calming agents and ritual mixtures. In its raw form, it remains a highly durable and valuable exotic crafting material.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.5; mostly blunt; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: jakobeast horn
rows.desc: A horn from a Jakobeast. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it is beautiful and sells for a decent price due to it's "mysterious properties".
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.5; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: skalder tusk
rows.desc: A skalder tusk. While somewhat unwieldy as a melee weapon, it can still be deadly.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.5; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: pustule hornet stinger
rows.desc: The stinger pulled from the body of a pustule hornet. It's usually not worth much, but it does make a decent unique weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 4.0; mostly blunt; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: bantha horn
rows.desc: A bantha's horn. Good enough to fend off some enemies. Comes as at least a pair, so not as valuable as other horns out there.
rows.role: melee, DPS 3.4; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object

rows.label: zygolophodon tusk
rows.desc: A zygolophodon's enormous tusk. Extremely durable and valuable. Way too big to be effectively used as a weapon.
rows.role: melee, DPS 0.9; mostly scratch; a body part, not a made object
